sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Not to be confused with the sphere, Leomurg.

Liomerg is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He is the disciple of Barion, the Dragon Demon who rules the land of Fal Nerga.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Liomerg appeared in front of Summoner soon after the party arrived in Fal Nerga. He challenged Summoner to a duel and after Summoner defeated him, he revealed that he knows Karl before he went.

In Light Dragonton Sinn, he appeared again to take Karl away because the latter had troubles in controlling his power. In Mt. Nerga, he remarked that his master's son chose to side with the humans after all, and challenged Summoner to a battle to stall for the preparation of Barion's ritual.

Liomerg appeared again in Estria after Shusui's death, where he scolded Karl for being too arrogant and questioned why Shusui chose Summoner to bear the title of "Strongest", instead of his young master, who inherited Barion's power. Later in Menon, he thanked Karl after the latter reclaimed Barion's power, and it is revealed that he has joined Bertz.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Liomerg's character unit, Disciple Liomerg, is available as a first-clear reward from Grand Gaia Chronicles: Blue-Blood Revelation, Vol. 2.
